Original Requirement: Users should be able to reset their passwords easily.
Clarifications: How should users reset passwords? -> Through a registered email address.; Should the reset link expire? -> Yes, after 15 minutes.
Context: The system is a web-based application.
Discovery Answers: Who can use this feature? -> Registered users
Translated Requirement: Registered users must be able to reset their passwords via a link sent to their registered email address that expires after 15 minutes.

Clarifications: What is the response time? -> Within 2 seconds.
Translated Requirement: The system must respond within 2 seconds.

Clarifications: What information is displayed? -> Order status and estimated delivery date.
Discovery Answers: Who can track orders? -> Logged-in customers
Translated Requirement: Logged-in customers must be able to view their order status and estimated delivery date.

Clarifications: What security measures are required? -> Password hashing and two-factor authentication.
Translated Requirement: The application must implement password hashing and two-factor authentication for user security.

Clarifications: What management operations are allowed? -> Create, update, deactivate and view accounts.
Discovery Answers: Who has admin privileges? -> Authorized university administrators
Translated Requirement: Authorized university administrators must be able to create, update, deactivate, and view user accounts.

Clarifications: Which notification channels? -> Email and in-app notifications.; When are notifications sent? -> When an order is placed or its status changes.
Translated Requirement: The system must send both email and in-app notifications to users whenever an order is placed or its status changes.

Original Requirement: The system should support many users.
Clarifications: How many concurrent users? -> Up to 500 concurrent users.
Translated Requirement: The system must support up to 500 concurrent users.

Clarifications: When can students register? -> During the announced registration period.; Can students register for full courses? -> No, only courses with available seats.
Translated Requirement: Students must only register for courses with available seats during the announced registration period.

Clarifications: Which file formats are supported? -> PDF, DOCX and JPG.; What is the maximum size? -> 10 MB per file.
Translated Requirement: Users can upload PDF, DOCX, and JPG documents with a maximum file size of 10 MB per file.

Original Requirement: The system should be available all the time.
Clarifications: What availability is required? -> 99.9% monthly uptime.
Translated Requirement: The healthcare appointment platform must maintain a 99.9% monthly uptime availability.

Original Requirement: Users can search for available products.
Clarifications: Which search filters are needed? -> Product name, category and price range.
Translated Requirement: Users can search for available products in the marketplace by product name, category, and price range.

Clarifications: Which report format is required? -> PDF and Excel.; Who can generate reports? -> Administrators only.
Translated Requirement: The management information system must allow only administrators to generate reports in PDF and Excel formats.
